result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall: the header, search bar, promo banner, carousels, and bottom navigation are aligned and legible. The only visible concern is a minor overlap of the delivery-time badge on the Green Bowl Poké image. The clipped chip and carousel items at the right edge and the cut-off card at the bottom were excluded as intended scroll and viewport behavior.

issues.description: The '15–25 min' badge on the Green Bowl Poké card overlaps the lower-left part of the dish image, partially covering the food.
issues.suggestion: Move the time badge to a consistent corner of the card, or add padding so it sits over a less important area of the image.
